name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room and pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires picking up the ball ('Get into the locked room and pick up the ball'), but the only clause is Existence(target_room_entered); reaching the room alone finishes the machine without target_picked_up ever happening. Add a hard Existence(target_picked_up); if the wording is read as an order, add Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) — which Existence(target_picked_up) plus the environment's constraints already satisfy — and drop the redundant Existence(target_room_entered) in that case. At minimum the pickup goal is missing.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) requires the ball, and Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) puts entering the room first, which together force target_room_entered as well.

texts: Enter the locked target room before picking up the target ball.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !target_picked_up&target_room_entered) -> u1
(u0, target_picked_up&!target_room_entered) -> u2
(u0, target_picked_up&target_room_entered) -> u3
(u1, target_picked_up) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !target_picked_up&target_room_entered, u1) -> 1
(u0, target_picked_up&!target_room_entered, u2) -> -10
(u0, target_picked_up&target_room_entered, u3) -> 12
(u1, target_picked_up, u3) -> 11
